mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations adjust downward.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of periods with declining GDP, or GDP growth and SPX returns show no significant negative correlation (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month indicates a strong supply-side response, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 300,000 in a month, it signals strong labor market conditions, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between PAYEMS increases and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% in a month, it indicates a weakening in the housing market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and related economic activity decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between HOUST declines and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% in a month, it signals a tightening monetary policy with high inflation, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns diminish.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.3% in 1 month
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect of high FEDFUNDS and increasing CPIAUCSL on SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and retail sales (RSAFS) decline by more than 1% in the most recent month, it signals a significant weakening in demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity contracts.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and RSAFS decreases > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect of negative GDPC1 growth and declining RSAFS on SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
